headline: Approved liquor license renewal for Majestic and new license for La Reprise Wines, plus outdoor consumption permits for Honey Road and Pascolo Ristorante
summary: The commission adopted a consent agenda approving a liquor license renewal for Majestic and one-day outside consumption permit expansions for Honey Road and Pascolo Ristorante. It also approved a new Third Class Liquor License for La Reprise Wines, LLC for 2026-2027.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, which included the 2026-2027 liquor license renewal for Majestic and one-day outside consumption permit expansions for Honey Road (September 26, 2026) and Pascolo Ristorante (September 19, 2026).
Approved the 2026-2027 Third Class Liquor License Application for La Reprise Wines, LLC with all standard conditions.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion made by Commissioner Schachter, seconded by Commissioner Grant, to adopt the consent agenda and take the actions indicated. Motion passed unanimously.
